shellCommands.command: cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md && find .agents -type f && cat AGENTS.md && ls -la && head -50 package-lock.json

cat package.json tsconfig.json vite.config.ts index.html .gitignore; find src __agent_eval__ -type f | head; for f in $(find src -type f); do echo "== $f"; cat $f; done; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui; head -80 .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md
rg -n -A 25 "^## Navigation" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md | head -250; cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs | head -60

sed -n 250,400p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md; npm view @gravity-ui/navigation version peerDependencies 2>&1 | head -30; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/package.json | grep '"version"'

npm install @gravity-ui/navigation@^7 @gravity-ui/icons@^2 @bem-react/classname 2>&1 | tail -5 && grep -A8 '"dependencies"' package.json && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/ node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build 2>/dev/null; .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh navigation AsideHeader FooterItem PageLayout

bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh navigation AsideHeader FooterItem 2>&1 | head -40; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/INDEX.md | head -60; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>&1

N=node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm; rg -n "renderFooter|FooterItem" $N/components/AsideHeader/types.d.ts $N/components/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; find $N -name "*.d.ts" -path "*FooterItem*" | head -3; find $N -name "types.d.ts" -path "*Logo*"; curl -s -m 15 -o /tmp/uikit7.txt -w "%{http_code}\n" https://gravity-ui.com/llms/uikit/7/llms.txt; wc -c /tmp/uikit7.txt

N=node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm; sed -n 55,70p $N/components/AsideHeader/types.d.ts; cat $N/components/AsideHeader/components/FooterItem/FooterItem.d.ts; rg -n "FooterItem|AsideHeader\b|AsideHeaderItem" $N/index.d.ts $N/components/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; find $N/components/Logo -name "*.d.ts" | xargs cat | head -40

U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components; cat $U/Card/Card.d.ts | sed -n 1,40p; rg -n "variant|color" $U/Text/text/text.d.ts $U/Text/colorText/colorText.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -20; ls $U/Text $U/SegmentedRadioGroup; cat $U/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroup.d.ts | head -30; rg -n "theme\?|size\?|type\?" $U/Label/Label.d.ts; rg -n "^export (type|interface)" $U/theme/*.d.ts | head; rg -n "useTheme|useThemeType|useThemeValue" $U/theme/index.d.ts

U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components; rg -n "TEXT_COLORS|TEXT_VARIANTS" -A3 $U/Text/colorText/colorText.d.ts $U/Text/text/text.d.ts | head; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/colorText/constants.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -5; find $U/Text -name "*.d.ts" | xargs rg -n "TEXT_COLORS =|TEXT_VARIANTS =" ; rg -n -A14 "interface ControlGroupProps" $U/types.d.ts; cat $U/Text/Text.d.ts | rg -n "as\?|interface"; rg -n "Theme\b|ThemeType" node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/package.json | head -1

U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components; grep -rn "TEXT_COLORS" $U/Text --include=*.d.ts | head -3; grep -o '"[a-z-]*"' $U/Text/colorText/colorText.d.ts | head -0; sed -n 1,6p $U/Text/colorText/colorText.d.ts; grep -n "TEXT_COLORS" -A2 $U/Text/colorText/*.js 2>/dev/null | head; cat $U/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroupOption.d.ts | head -20; cd node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons && ls | grep -E "^(House|Sun|Moon|Gear|ChartColumn|Persons|ListUl|Person|SquareListUl|Rocket|Bell|CircleInfo|LayoutCells)\.d\.ts$"

cd /home/sandbox/workspace && U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components; rg -n "^\s+(direction|gap|wrap|alignItems|justifyContent|spacing|grow|width)\??:" $U/layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts $U/layout/Box/Box.d.ts 2>/dev/null; grep -nE "^\s+(direction|gap|wrap|alignItems|justifyContent|spacing|width)\??:" $U/layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts $U/layout/Box/Box.d.ts; grep -nE "checked|onUpdate|content|size" $U/Switch/Switch.d.ts $U/types.d.ts | head -12; grep -n "sp\b\|spacing" $U/layout/index.d.ts
